text:
jia: Quick ask — I'm seeing a small throughput regression on the multi-model path (gpt-medium & reranker combo). Can someone capture a compact trace bundle for the failing job? Need both nsys and torch.profiler outputs plus a tiny sample prompt set. SLO: <5% throughput delta.

alex: I can do capture tomorrow AM. Which exact docker image + command? Also what's the preferred upload path and redaction checklist?

jia: thx — image is inference:v3.2-rc (sha: abc123def). Capture command we use:
```
nsys profile --output=run1 --sample=cpu --trace=nvtx,cuda --capture-range=nvtx --force-overwrite --target-command \"python -m app.serve --model gpt-medium --batch-size 4\" 
```
and the torch.profiler snippet in the container:
```
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA], schedule=torch.profiler.schedule(wait=1,warmup=2,active=5), record_shapes=True, profile_memory=True) as prof:
    for it in range(8):
        model.step(batch)

prof.export_chrome_trace(\"/tmp/torch_trace.json\")
```

maria: upload to s3://redwood-perf/artifact-packets/<team>/2390012345/ please prefer tar.gz. Max single object 5GB. If >5GB, split into part-*.tar.gz and include manifest.txt with checksums.

sam: redaction: remove /home/ and /etc/ env vars, strip tokens from logs. Prefer `sed -E` script we keep in infra: `/opt/scripts/redact-trace.sh`.

leo: can we gate this with the perf CI? If we add a small metadata file {"ci_gate":true} in the manifest, perf-bot will index and run an automated lightweight regression check. Otherwise it's manual.

jia: yes add metadata, thanks. Also include the minimal prompt set (10 prompts) in prompts.json and note the exact commit used.

alex: picking this up in 30m. Will attach a tiny sample trace first to make sure upload path works.

sam: pinging infra-bot for temp creds — @infra-bot can you create a presigned upload URL for s3://redwood-perf/artifact-packets/eng-runtime/2390012345/ ?

infra-bot: Created presigned URL (valid 6h). Upload endpoint: https://storage-redwood.example/presign/abcXYZ. Manifest template posted in #eng-infra.

alex: uploaded run1.tar.gz (1.2GB) and manifest.txt (md5sums). Also uploaded prompts.json and torch_trace.json. link: s3://redwood-perf/artifact-packets/eng-runtime/2390012345/run1.tar.gz

maria: I kicked off the lightweight regression job. perf-bot will post results in ~10m.

perf-bot: Regression check started against baseline 2026-02-27. Samples: 10 prompts. Estimated runtime ~2m.

perf-bot: Regression check finished — no significant throughput regression detected (observed -1.2% within noise). Full artifact ingestion complete and indexed under perf-dashboard / model-comparisons -> 2390012345.

leo: cool. alex would you please attach the small flamegraph PNG (for quick triage) to the ticket? Also note if KV cache warmup was observed in logs.

alex: attached flamegraph: flame_2390012345.png. KV cache warmup visible for first 2 iterations, then steady-state.

jia: amazing, thanks all. Will close this as resolved unless someone sees a followup. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks! added a follow-up todo in the perf board to check batching heuristics next week.

maria: archived the packet and added retention 90d. Closing.

perf-bot: Thread marked resolved.
